newsitem.title: INDIA: India to open mining, lignite to foreign equity.
newsitem.headline: India to open mining, lignite to foreign equity.

text.p: Indian Coal Minister Kanti Singh said on Tuesday that the government will propose allowing foreign equity in Indian coal and lignite mining companies.

"Foreign equity will be allowed in Indian companies," Singh told a news conference. He said the government will propose allowing foreign equity in Indian coal and lignite mining companies in a bill to be submitted to parliament.
Singh said foreign equity investment would be bound by guidelines set by the Foreign Investment Promotion Board (FIPB). "It will be based on FIPB guidelines. The FIPB will direct on it," he said.

Earlier on Tuesday, the government announced that it will propose allowing Indian companies to mine coal and lignite for captive consumption and sale. "No foreign company will be invited for the exploration," Singh said.
